title: Okay Awesome
cn: 第 5 集 · 夜店与桌游
novel:
Robin got them into a famous [[nightclub|nightclub]]. A huge [[bouncer|bouncer]] lifted the [[velvet rope|velvet rope]], and suddenly they were [[VIPs|VIP]].

Inside, the music was [[deafening|deafening]]. The [[bass|bass]] made Ted's chest [[throb|throb]]. Hundreds of [[sweaty|sweaty]] bodies were [[crammed|cram]] together, and he had to [[squeeze|squeeze]] sideways just to reach the bar. Lights turned every face into a [[blur|blur]].

Barney shouted that this was the greatest night of their lives. Ted nodded and thought about his sofa.

He was thirty minutes in and already [[exhausted|exhausted]]. Was he [[immature|immature]] for staying, or too [[mature|mature]] to enjoy it? Had he simply [[outgrown|outgrow]] this kind of fun?

Meanwhile Marshall and Lily stayed home in [[cosy|cosy]] socks, playing a [[board game|board game]] and eating ice cream. They were [[thrilled|thrilled]]. They felt no [[longing|longing]] for the loud world outside at all.

At two in the morning the excitement finally [[wore off|wear off]]. Ted stood on the street with ringing ears and understood something quietly: you do not have to love a place to [[belong|belong]] somewhere.

He went home, took the last spoon of ice cream, and lost the board game badly.

nightclub.en: a place open late at night for dancing and drinking

bouncer.en: a strong person at a club door who keeps out people they do not want

velvet rope.en: the soft rope at a club door that separates important guests from the queue

VIP.en: a special guest who gets better treatment

deafening.en: so loud that you cannot hear anything else

bass.en: the low, deep sounds in music

throb.en: to beat strongly again and again

cram.en: to push too many things or people into a small space

squeeze.en: to move through a space that is too narrow

immature.en: behaving like a child, not like an adult

mature.en: behaving in a sensible, adult way

outgrow.en: to stop liking something because you have grown older

board game.en: a game played on a flat board, like chess

longing.en: a strong wish for something you do not have

wear off.en: to slowly disappear, like a feeling or a medicine

belong.en: to feel happy and right in a place or group
